title: Oops! All Advancements!
description: This is a datapack I created to add WAY too many advancements into the game. I plan to add over 100 so I can really say there are too many advancements.
body: This is a datapack I created to add WAY too many advancements into the game. I plan to add over 100 so I can really say there are too many advancements. I also plan to add a version where the advancements aren't given their own tab, instead mixed in with all the Minecraft advancements. If you have any feedback feel free to comment on suggestions for advancements or ways I can improve. Have fun!
